Application Data.NAME: Global Travel Agency Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Global Travel Agency Inc. specializes in arranging personalized travel experiences for clients, including leisure and corporate travel. We provide comprehensive services such as flight booking, hotel reservations, travel insurance, and itinerary planning. Our agency has established partnerships with reputable airlines, hotels, and tour operators, ensuring reliable and quality service for our customers. We fully comply with consumer protection laws and maintain robust risk management practices, including comprehensive Errors & Omissions (E&O) coverage and employee training on compliance and customer service standards. Our focus on delivering exceptional travel experiences, combined with our commitment to client communication, positions us as a trusted partner in the travel industry.
